degree.text: Degree Awarded Bachelor Degree of Engineering.

description.text: Education Objectives The educational aim of Petroleum Engineering specialty is to cultivate students with advanced technology and engineering knowledge. Students also be engaged in petroleum engineering design, operation and construction, production and management, scientific development and applied research Main Courses Technological Economics, Oil and Gas Development Geology, Engineering Mechanics, Computer Programming, Fluid Mechanics, Permeation Fluid Mechanics, Drilling Engineering, Oil Extraction, Petroleum Reservoir Engineering, Oilfield Chemistry, Drilling New Technology, etc. Internship Practice, course design, surveying and mapping practice, graduation practice, graduation design. Degree Awarded Bachelor Degree of Engineering. Career Graduates can be comprehensive talents to make research; teaching or management related this field in the scientific institute, university or enterprise etc.

duration.text: The Oil and Gas Storage and Transportation Engineering at China University of Petroleum - Beijing is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3333 USD/per year ￥ 24000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Academic transcript of high school 5.HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) 6.The identity certificate of the guarantors charging your case in China For example, photocopy of ID card, photocopy of passport, etc.

requirements.text: 1. High school graduate or equivalent or above. Above avarage in academic performance in high schools; 2. HSK Level 4; 3. (Applicants should be between the) age of 18 to 30 4. Be in good health; 5. Academic performance is above average and courses are 80% or above; 6. With basic English language ability
